IncidentDef.label: replicator-consumed ruins discovered
IncidentDef.letterText: Long-range survey data has exposed the remains of a technological site dismantled from the inside out. Walls end in regular block-sized scars and most machinery has been stripped to empty frames. Dense Replicator Matter remains among the debris: useful evidence of how the swarm consumes technology, but also a live containment problem. Ordinary uncontained Matter can begin self-assembly after roughly half a RimWorld day; secure or suppress it before treating the site as salvage.
